description: This file defines the QualificationSkillController class within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component for qualification skill listing during the pre-render phase.

classes.name: QualificationSkillController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling qualification skill views, extending the AbstractVueController and setting up the qualification-skill-list Vue component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by instantiating the 'qualification-skill-list' Vue component and attaching it to the controller.
